## PROPHYLAXIS AGAINST MYCOBACTERIUM AVIUM DISEASE IN PERSONS WITH HIV/AIDS
Infectious Diseases should be involved in all cases. Patients with CD4 count <
50 cells per microliter, after ruling out disseminated MC disease, should
receive prophylaxis until CD4 count is >100 for at least 3 months in response to
antiretroviral therapy.
## Preferred prophylaxis
[Azithromycin 1200 mg PO q week ($) [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-1200mg-po-q-week)
## Alternative
[Clarithromycin 500 mg PO BID ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-clarithromycin-500mg-po-q12h)
